column1: Order came 35 minutes after the ETA and the app still said arriving soon.
Food was cold because the driver took a long route with two other deliveries.
Support took forever to respond when my order was missing.
The delivery estimate said 25 min, but it took almost an hour.
I couldn't find the refund status after the restaurant cancelled my order.
Checkout failed twice when I tried to use my saved card.
Offers look good but the discount disappeared at checkout.
Tracking stopped updating for 20 minutes and I had no idea where my order was.
